title: Privacy policy
lead: This page explains which details we collect through this website, what we use them for and what you can ask of us.
draftNotice: This page is a draft. Smallfold is not a registered business yet, and the owner or a lawyer must check this page before the site goes public.

sections.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: This website is run by Smallfold, which finds sponsors for small YouTube channels. Smallfold is not a registered business yet. Its legal name is <mark class="blank">(legal name to be added)</mark> and it is based in <mark class="blank">(country to be added)</mark>. In this policy, “we” means Smallfold.

sections.heading: What we collect
paragraphs: If you apply as a creator, the application form asks for your name, your email address, a link to your YouTube channel, what the channel is about and its subscriber count. A phone number is optional.
If you send a brand inquiry, the form asks for your company, what you want to promote, a budget range, your name and your email address. A phone number is optional.
If you write to us by email, we receive your email address and whatever you choose to tell us.

sections.heading: How we use your details
paragraphs: We use the details in an application to look at your channel, to reply to you and to find a sponsor that suits your channel.
We use the details in a brand inquiry to reply to you and to suggest channels that suit what you want to promote.
The legal basis for using your details is <mark class="blank">(legal basis to be added)</mark>.

sections.heading: Services that handle your details
paragraphs: Each form is delivered to our email inbox through a form-handling service <mark class="blank">(name of the form service to be added)</mark>. Your details pass through that service on the way to us. Our inbox is a Gmail account, provided by Google.
This site loads its fonts from Google Fonts. To fetch them, your browser contacts Google’s servers, and Google receives your IP address as part of that request.
What we pass on to a sponsor about a creator, and to a creator about a sponsor, is <mark class="blank">(details shared in a match to be added)</mark>.

sections.heading: Cookies
paragraphs: This site sets no advertising cookies and no analytics cookies.

The opening animation on the home page plays once per visit. To do that, the site keeps one small note in your browser’s session storage, which holds no personal details and is removed when you close the browser tab.

sections.heading: How long we keep details
paragraphs: We keep the details you send us for <mark class="blank">(retention period to be added)</mark>.

sections.heading: What you can ask of us
paragraphs: You can ask us to show you the details we hold about you, to correct them or to delete them. Write to us at small.fold.sponsorship@gmail.com.
Our contact for data protection is <mark class="blank">(data protection contact to be added)</mark>.

sections.heading: Changes to this page
paragraphs: We may change this page. The date at the top shows when it was last changed.
